Create a minimalist black and white flat vector portrait of [NAME] in an expressive Notion-avatar style.

Line work and mood:
Use thick, consistent monoline black outlines. The drawing should feel smooth, organic, confident, and hand-designed rather than stiff, robotic, or generic. Give the character a clear personality with a relaxed, cool, or friendly expression. Emphasize distinctive facial features, hairstyle, facial hair, accessories, and other identity details.

Selective black fills:
Keep the style mostly outline-based, but use solid black areas deliberately. Fill major dark shapes such as hair masses, beards, eyebrows, sunglasses, or dark clothing. Leave skin, the main face area, and lighter details as pure flat white inside the bold outlines.

Composition and technical style:
Center the character as a clean bust or headshot on a white background. Use only pure black and pure white. No gray, no shading, no gradients, no soft lighting. The final image should read as high-contrast, crisp 2D vector graphics with a polished avatar-system feel.\

- Silhouette priority
- Minimal expression of hair strands
- Highlight at the top

Body:

- Short arms
- Short legs

- Minimal joint expression

- Single character only
- Full body display
- Centered placement

Goal: Create a vertical retro-futurist editorial poster about artificial intelligence and human delegation, combining classical sculpture, exposed machinery, and 1990s computer error UI.

Canvas: Tall portrait poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, aged beige paper background with subtle stains, grain, cracks, and technical drafting marks. Use muted sepia, stone gray, rust orange, dark graphite, blue, and off-white tones.

Main subject: A broken classical marble bust of a bearded Greek/Roman philosopher, shown from chest to head, occupying the right two-thirds of the poster. The bust is cracked and partially shattered, revealing dense cybernetic internals: tangled cables, circuit boards, ribbon wires, metal tubes, small components, and mechanical layers inside the skull and torso. The face area is deliberately covered by one large opaque square censor block in muted taupe-gray, centered over the eyes/nose/mouth region. The bust has curly stone hair and beard fragments, chipped shoulders, and missing chunks of marble around the right side of the head and body.

Typography and poster text: On the upper left, set a large editorial headline reading “AI IS THINKING SO I DON'T HAVE TO”. Make “AI” very large in rusty orange serif type, “IS” smaller in black serif type, “THINKING” bold condensed sans serif in dark gray, “SO I DON'T HAVE” in tall elegant serif, and “TO” in rusty orange serif. Beneath the headline, include exactly 3 short stacked lines: “DELEGATION”, “AS EVOLUTION.”, “COMPLACENCY”, followed by “AS DESIGN.” on the next line as a compact micro-caption block. Add a small orange Roman numeral “III” nearby.

Error window: Place exactly 1 old Windows-style dialog box across the bust’s lower chest, with a blue title bar reading “Fatal Error”, a gray body, a red circle icon with a white X, a close button in the top right, and message text: “System failure at address 0041:7B3E\nThe operation completed successfully.” Include exactly 1 rectangular “OK” button and exactly 1 large pixelated white cursor arrow pointing at or overlapping the OK button.

Data overlay: Add exactly 1 black binary-code glitch shape dripping down from the lower right of the dialog box and over the exposed circuitry, made of repeated 0s and 1s. It should look like melting digital residue.

Background technical details: Add thin black drafting lines, crop marks, dotted grids, measurement ticks, crosshair points, and faint geometric diagrams. Include exactly 1 circular construction diagram in the lower left quadrant. Include exactly 1 small orange nested-corner logo mark near the bottom left. Include exactly 1 small label at top left reading “Fig. 01”. Along the left margin, include vertical microtext reading “MIND / MACHINE INTERFACE” and small coordinate-like text in orange. Add a tiny calculation block near the lower left reading “CALC. // HUMAN INPUT 0.001%”.

Visual style: High-detail photomontage collage, museum sculpture realism mixed with cyberpunk exposed hardware, Swiss editorial layout, brutalist typography, distressed printed texture, subtle halftone dots, precise grid composition, cinematic shadows, realistic stone dust and chipped marble edges.

Constraints: Use exactly 1 bust, exactly 1 censor square, exactly 1 error dialog, exactly 1 cursor, exactly 1 binary drip shape, exactly 1 circular diagram, and exactly 1 orange nested-corner logo. Do not add extra people, extra windows, modern glossy UI, neon colors, or watermark.\

Behind her, fill almost the entire background with enormous condensed block typography reading HER19845, cropped at the edges, using a gritty orange-to-pink-to-purple gradient with distressed texture. Add an energetic orange handwritten signature/scribble overlay across the right-middle area, partially crossing the model and the large number forms.

She wears a white cropped ribbed tank top, layered necklaces, an oversized black zip hoodie with white lining and colorful paint-splatter graphics, very loose black drawstring streetwear pants with orange, pink, and purple graffiti marks, and chunky black-white-orange sneakers. Pose is relaxed, confident, rebellious, fashion campaign style.

Visible text content: Include exactly 9 distinct text elements: 1) giant background headline: “HER19845”; 2) left bold tagline: “REBEL. UNFILTERED. ICON IN PROGRESS.”; 3) left paragraph: “Built on raw energy and real ambition. This is not for everyone. This is for HER.”; 4) lower-left issue line: “VOL. 08 / MMXXV”; 5) lower-left pink slogan stacked in three lines: “THE CULTURE / THE VISION / THE FUTURE”; 6) right bracketed label: “[HER19845]”; 7) small pink right slogan: “NOT YOURS. NEVER WAS.”; 8) bottom-left black-and-white label: “PARENTAL ADVISORY EXPLICIT CONTENT”; 9) orange handwritten mark reading After19845. Also include two tiny graphic icons under the right slogan: a simple globe icon and a small barcode.

Visual style: High-contrast studio fashion photography blended with bold graphic poster design, sharp full-body lighting, slight floor shadow, grunge print texture, contemporary youth-culture zine aesthetic, neon gradient typography, orange marker strokes, black/pink accent typography.

Place large hand-painted navy brush lettering “Dubai” at the top left. Under it add the serif tagline “WHERE DESERT MEETS SKYLINE” and a smaller cursive line “Where heritage rises into the future.” Add a vertical red Arabic calligraphy mark near the Burj Khalifa. At the top right place a circular black postal stamp reading “DUBAI · UAE” with a small dhow boat illustration and wavy postmark lines.

Main scene details: Show a lively old Dubai souk street with tan stone buildings, carved wind-tower architecture, wooden balconies, lanterns, flower-covered walls, and wet reflective cobblestones. In the center distance, Dubai Creek glows blue under a golden sunset, with small boats on the water and the Burj Khalifa rising dramatically in the skyline. Include the Burj Al Arab and other modern glass towers in the distance. Add birds in the sky and a United Arab Emirates flag on a boat canopy. On the right, include a palm tree and dense magenta bougainvillea cascading over the souk entrance. People wear traditional Gulf clothing: men in white kanduras and ghutras, women in black abayas, walking through the street.

Visible signs and text in the scene: Include exactly 4 prominent shop or location signs: 1) a large hanging sign on the left with Arabic text and “KARAK CHAI” plus a tea-cup icon, 2) a smaller black sign below it reading “KARAK CHAI” with a cup icon, 3) a right-side directional sign with Arabic text and “Gold Souk” plus a right arrow, 4) a gold shop sign in the lower strip with Arabic text and “GOLD.”

Foreground feature: At the lower left of the main scene, show a karak chai vendor stall made of dark wood. A vendor in white traditional clothing pours tea beside a brass kettle and a neat row of small tea glasses. The stall should feel warm, aromatic, and nostalgic.

Bottom travel-journal strip: The bottom third is separated like a scrapbook itinerary panel on aged paper. Include exactly 5 sections across this strip: 1) a left note card headed “Dubai” with the text “A city where every skyline tells two stories.” and exactly 4 illustrated bullet items: “Wind-tower heritage,” “Karak chai culture,” “Desert dunes nearby,” and “Futuristic skyline”; 2) a narrow framed watercolor vignette labeled “Dubai Creek,” showing a dhow boat at sunset; 3) a narrow framed vignette labeled “Gold Souk,” showing a glowing gold market alley; 4) a narrow framed vignette labeled “Downtown,” showing skyscrapers, Burj Khalifa, and fountains at night; 5) a right map panel showing the United Arab Emirates coastline with a red location pin and the handwritten label “Dubai.” Add the small uppercase text “UNITED ARAB EMIRATES,” a compass rose, the quote “Between sand and sky, Dubai dreams in gold.” and a small red stamp with Arabic text “دبي.”

Visual style: Romantic vintage travel illustration, watercolor and gouache, fine ink sketch details, warm ochre stone, turquoise creek water, navy lettering, gold sunset sky, magenta flowers, atmospheric perspective, dense but legible poster design.

Constraints: Keep all text hand-lettered but readable. Use the exact counted elements specified: 4 prominent shop/location signs, 5 bottom-strip sections, and 4 bullet items in the left note card. Do not add logos, watermarks, modern UI elements, or photorealistic rendering.\
